newsitem.title: ZAIRE: EU envoy says food must reach Zaire refugees.
newsitem.headline: EU envoy says food must reach Zaire refugees.

text.p: The European Union commissioner for humanitarian affairs said on Friday food aid must reach Hutu refugees and displaced Zaireans threatened by war and disease in eastern Zaire.
Emma Bonino, on a three-day visit to Zaire, told journalists after talks with government members that all concerned should ensure that food aid reached those in need without conditions.

"My appeal to the Zairean authorities and the message which I have passed on to other countries in the region is to facilitate access for humanitarian aid to the population in need without distinction for nationality," she said.

Bonino is due to travel to Tingi Tingi refugee camp deep in the Equatorial rainforest, where between 10 and 30 Rwandan Hutus, many of them children, have been dying per day since the beginning of the year.
"Humanitarian aid cannot be conditional," she added.

She said humanitarian agencies had been proved right when they called for international action to help several hundred thousand Rwandan Hutus who disappeared into the forest after Tutsi-led rebel attacks on refugee camps encouraged 600,000 other refugees to return home.
